Non reentrant for the same TxPduId. TxPduId Identifier of the I-PDU to be transmitted. Parameters (in) PduInfoPtr Length of and pointer to the signal data and pointer to MetaData. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : Transmit request has been accepted. COM_BUSY : Transmit request has been rejected due to minimum delay time violation.
